answer.answer: Sediment concentration (particles/kg dry weight) and water-column concentration (particles/m3) are measured in fundamentally different units and matrices, so they cannot be directly ranked as 'more polluted.' A valid comparison would require converting both to a common basis (e.g., mass or volume normalized) or using site-specific density/partitioning data, which is not provided here.
